remainingLimits: The three-receiver check used automated loopback clients; four physical phones have not been tested together.
A saved device must be reachable with the app available. The host cannot launch an app or power on an offline phone remotely.
An intentionally disconnected receiver may retain or recover its encrypted availability channel, but service output stays paused until the host reconnects it.
The tested W2 hotspot isolates Wi-Fi clients. Hosting from a phone providing its own hotspot remains unverified; current host address detection expects a Wi-Fi client interface.
Starting hosting remains explicit after host app restart; returning operator control always requires a fresh handover.
The LED-controller protocol is unchanged; no sign output or controller configuration was modified.
Long-duration endurance and Android process-death recovery have not been established by this update.
The existing local prototype signing key is retained for upgrade compatibility.
